entryPointCandidates.name: main.cpp
entryPointCandidates.summary: Application entry point for the CoreStationHXAgent; bootstraps the platform abstraction, manages serial communication and heartbeat threads, handles AMT COM port detection/reassignment via the Windows registry, and relays system state to the CoreStation HX CMC over serial.

entryPointCandidates.name: README.md
entryPointCandidates.summary: Primary project documentation describing the repository file layout, Linux build/install instructions (Ubuntu 24.04, debuild/.deb packaging, systemd service), and Windows build/usage instructions (build machine setup, day-to-day use, exe signing, service management, PowerShell execution policy, linting), plus reference tables for session-state and serial-output debug codes.

entryPointCandidates.name: MetricsCollector.cpp
entryPointCandidates.summary: Implements MetricsCollector's metric-gathering methods, calling into the Platform interface for CPU/RAM/disk/network/GPU/process/update data and assembling a formatted metrics string for transmission.

entryPointCandidates.name: setup-remotes.ps1
entryPointCandidates.summary: One-time PowerShell setup script that configures git remotes after cloning, adding a GitHub mirror remote and a combined 'all' remote with push URLs pointing to both Bitbucket and GitHub.

list.name: Entry Point
list.description: Application bootstrap that wires up the platform abstraction, manages the serial/heartbeat threads, AMT COM port detection, and the agent's version metadata.

list.name: Platform Abstraction
list.description: The OS-agnostic interface (Platform, SystemState) that defines the contract for networking, serial I/O, and system metrics, decoupling the agent's core logic from concrete OS implementations.

list.name: Platform Implementations
list.description: Concrete Windows and Linux implementations of the Platform interface, including Windows service lifecycle, COM/WMI/PDH metric collection, registry access, and D-Bus/syslog integration on Linux.

list.name: Feature Modules
list.description: Self-contained hardware and OS-integration modules consumed primarily from main.cpp: serial communication, metrics collection/caching, Windows service management, session monitoring, tray UI, registry editing, and HX2K/HX3K CPU detection.

list.name: Build System
list.description: CMake build configuration, Windows/Linux build and signing scripts, Windows resource files, and repository setup utilities that compile and version the agent executable.

list.name: Deployment & Packaging
list.description: Windows service installer/uninstaller scripts, the systemd unit, and the full Debian packaging toolchain (control, rules, postinst/postrm/prerm, compat files) that package and deploy the agent as a host service.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project README and release-notes/changelog files describing build, install, and usage instructions plus the chronological history of agent releases.

file:src/core/Platform.h.name: Platform.h
file:src/core/Platform.h.summary: Defines the abstract Platform interface that exposes all OS-specific operations (networking, serial I/O, system metrics, GPU info, dialogs) required by the agent, allowing platform-specific implementations to be swapped behind a common API.

file:src/core/SystemState.h.name: SystemState.h
file:src/core/SystemState.h.summary: Defines the NetworkInterface and SystemState plain-data structures that capture a snapshot of host networking, session, and performance metrics for change detection and reporting.

file:src/modules/metrics/MetricCache.h.name: MetricCache.h
file:src/modules/metrics/MetricCache.h.summary: Generic, thread-safe TTL cache template that stores the last computed value of an expensive metric and only recomputes it once the configured time-to-live has elapsed, plus a CacheDurations namespace of per-metric TTL constants.

file:src/modules/metrics/MetricsCollecto.name: MetricsCollector.h
file:src/modules/metrics/MetricsCollecto.summary: Declares the MetricsCollector class, which orchestrates periodic collection of performance, GPU, process, and Windows Update metrics from a Platform implementation, with optional per-metric caching.

file:src/modules/metrics/MetricsCollecto.name: MetricsCollector.cpp
file:src/modules/metrics/MetricsCollecto.summary: Implements MetricsCollector's metric-gathering methods, calling into the Platform interface for CPU/RAM/disk/network/GPU/process/update data and assembling a formatted metrics string for transmission.

file:src/main.cpp.name: main.cpp
file:src/main.cpp.summary: Application entry point for the CoreStationHXAgent; bootstraps the platform abstraction, manages serial communication and heartbeat threads, handles AMT COM port detection/reassignment via the Windows registry, and relays system state to the CoreStation HX CMC over serial.

file:src/modules/3kcheck/3kcheck.h.name: 3kcheck.h
file:src/modules/3kcheck/3kcheck.h.summary: Windows-only header declaring CPUInfo and helper functions to retrieve CPU details and determine whether the host is an HX2K-class CPU configuration (vs. HX3K), used to select the correct serial COM port.

file:src/modules/serial/SerialManager.cp.name: SerialManager.cpp
file:src/modules/serial/SerialManager.cp.summary: Cross-platform implementation of serial port communication (open/close/read/write/reconnect) supporting both Windows (CreateFileA/HANDLE) and POSIX (termios) backends, with message framing and retry-delay-based reconnection logic.

file:src/modules/serial/SerialManager.h.name: SerialManager.h
file:src/modules/serial/SerialManager.h.summary: Declares the cross-platform SerialManager class, providing an interface for opening, closing, reading, writing, and auto-reconnecting a serial port, with platform-specific handle storage for Windows and POSIX.

file:src/version.h.name: version.h
file:src/version.h.summary: Defines the agent's version number components (major/minor/release/build/extraversion/RC/adhoc), the default serial port path, and a human-readable application description.

file:build.bat.name: build.bat
file:build.bat.summary: Windows batch script that initializes the MSVC build environment via vswhere/vcvarsall, configures and builds the CoreStationHXAgent CMake project in Release mode, locates the resulting executable, copies it (and release-notes.txt) into the installer directory, and reports build time and file size.

file:build.sh.name: build.sh
file:build.sh.summary: Linux/cross-compile shell script that generates git_info.h from current git branch/hash/build time, compiles Windows resources with windres, and cross-compiles a static Windows .exe using the MinGW-w64 toolchain (x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix), linking the required Win32 system libraries.

file:src/modules/3kcheck/3kcheck.cpp.name: 3kcheck.cpp
file:src/modules/3kcheck/3kcheck.cpp.summary: Windows-only CPU detection module that uses the __cpuid intrinsic to read CPU vendor/brand strings and determine whether the host is an HX2K-class CPU (Core Ultra 165H/165U/285H) versus HX3K, replacing an earlier NIC-based detection approach.

file:src/modules/regedits/Regedit.cpp.name: Regedit.cpp
file:src/modules/regedits/Regedit.cpp.summary: Implements the Regedit class's Windows Registry operations (Read, Write, Create, Delete), parsing root-key/subkey paths and using Win32 Reg* APIs with logging via the parent WindowsPlatform.

file:src/modules/regedits/Regedit.h.name: Regedit.h
file:src/modules/regedits/Regedit.h.summary: Declares the Regedit class providing a small cross-cutting API (Read/Write/Create/Delete) for Windows Registry access on behalf of the parent WindowsPlatform.

file:src/modules/service/ServiceManager..name: ServiceManager.cpp
file:src/modules/service/ServiceManager..summary: Implements the ServiceManager class, providing full Windows Service Control Manager (SCM) lifecycle handling: install/uninstall, start/stop, status query and reporting, the service main and control-handler callbacks, and Win32 error formatting helpers.

file:src/modules/service/ServiceManager..name: ServiceManager.h
file:src/modules/service/ServiceManager..summary: Declares the ServiceManager class and its nested ServiceConfig/ServiceStatus structs, exposing the full Windows Service lifecycle API (install, uninstall, start, stop, status query, SCM callbacks) used by the agent to run itself as a Windows service.

file:src/modules/session/SessionMonitor..name: SessionMonitor.cpp
file:src/modules/session/SessionMonitor..summary: Implements the SessionMonitor class: creates a hidden window subscribed to WTS session-change notifications (logon/logoff, lock/unlock, console/RDP connect) on a dedicated thread and reports state transitions via callback, plus a helper to query current session state including logged-in user and desktop type.

file:src/modules/session/SessionMonitor..name: SessionMonitor.h
file:src/modules/session/SessionMonitor..summary: Declares the SessionMonitor class, which watches Windows Terminal Services (WTS) session-state changes via a hidden window and reports them through a callback function.

file:src/modules/tray/TrayApp.cpp.name: TrayApp.cpp
file:src/modules/tray/TrayApp.cpp.summary: Implements the TrayApp class: manages a Windows system tray icon showing hostname/IP/uptime, running a UI thread for the tray window and a named-pipe listener thread that parses incoming key=value updates from the agent process to refresh the displayed tooltip.

file:src/modules/tray/TrayApp.h.name: TrayApp.h
file:src/modules/tray/TrayApp.h.summary: Declares the TrayApp class, which displays a Windows system tray icon with hostname/IP/uptime information updated via UI and named-pipe listener threads.

file:src/platform/LinuxPlatform.cpp.name: LinuxPlatform.cpp
file:src/platform/LinuxPlatform.cpp.summary: Linux-specific implementation of the Platform interface, providing serial port I/O, network interface enumeration, system metrics (CPU/RAM/disk/GPU), D-Bus session monitoring, and syslog-based logging for the host agent.

file:src/platform/Windows_Addon.h.name: Windows_Addon.h
file:src/platform/Windows_Addon.h.summary: Small header of Windows-specific RAII helpers: custom deleters for HANDLE and PDH_HQUERY smart pointers, and a COM library initializer/uninitializer wrapper.

file:src/platform/WindowsPlatform.cpp.name: WindowsPlatform.cpp
file:src/platform/WindowsPlatform.cpp.summary: Windows-specific implementation of the Platform interface and Windows Service entry point: handles SCM service lifecycle, serial port I/O, network/adapter enumeration via IP Helper API, WMI-based GPU driver queries, PDH performance counters, registry-based OS version detection, and high-RAM process discovery.

file:src/platform/WindowsPlatform.h.name: WindowsPlatform.h
file:src/platform/WindowsPlatform.h.summary: Declares the WindowsPlatform class implementing the Platform interface for Windows, including service-management members, PDH counters, COM initializer, metric caches, and Windows-specific helper methods.
